title: Mussels Tacos with Citrusy Slaw
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Mexican-inspired dish featuring fresh mussels, served in tacos with a refreshing citrusy slaw.
instructions: Rinse the mussels under cold water and remove any broken shells.
In a large bowl, combine lime and orange juice, ginger, cumin, coriander, and salt.
Add the mussels to the bowl and toss to coat.
Let the mussels marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the mussels to the skillet and cook until they open, about 2-3 minutes.
Remove the mussels from the skillet and set aside.
In a separate bowl, combine the shredded red cabbage, thinly sliced red onion, and chopped cilantro.
Serve the mussels in tacos with the citrusy slaw on top.
